profile.headline: Software Engineer | Visa | Amazon |  Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Currently working full time as a Software Engineer.
Key Experiences:
- Exposed with the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, PowerBI, and QlikView
- Practical Experience in Statistical Modeling
- Implemented predictive Machine Learning algorithms in R and Python
- Performed  SQL queries on Google Analytics database
- Extract data from different sources using scrapper in Python
- Building software applications using AWS services

positions.title: Software Engineer - Visa Digital Developer Platform
Software Engineer - Visa Identity Access Management
Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote infrastructure code to spin up the AWS resources such as Ec2, Autoscaling Group, VPC service endpoints, load balancers, target groups, lambdas
• Created metrics, dashboards and alarms around service’s performance, availability, risks and errors
• Constructed throttling configuration based on real-time metrics to prevent the service resources from browning out and safe keeping the dependency services because of overwhelming client requests
• Reduced deployment time by 30% by altering the health checks for the target groups in AWS CodeDeploy

positions.title: Data Science Analyst
positions.description:
•	Designed a Supplier Web interface in JavaScript, HTML & CSS to assist the Quality Engineers in their Reach Across process. Neo4j, graph database, used to integrate data from various sources in the organization
•	Forecasted trend of defects for parts supplied by the suppliers for the next 3, 6, 12 months to reduce the cost of maintenance in aircraft. Microsoft SQL Server was used to accumulate dataset for 1400 suppliers, parts supplied, and factors involved in defects. Python Libraries were the driving force in the implementation of Predictive Algorithms and Time Series Models like ARIMA, Vector Auto Regression, and Recurrent Neural Networks. Measured accuracy of the models using MAE and MSE metrics.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Analyzed over 5000 recruitment resumes improving the hiring process of the new employees 
•	Research organization’s customers’ data and predicted customers preference based on order history to maximize sales output using regression and classification algorithms
•	Created Employee Management System and displayed Dashboards in Tableau using features such as Table Calculations, Aggregate functions, and stories to produce monthly HR report of employees
•	Programmed complex T-SQL procedures for data extraction by utilizing knowledge of joins

positions.title: Java Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with other interns in programming multiple modules for Kerala Law Management System which enhances the previous system to make it more User-Friendly and extend functionalities
• Optimized 10,000 lines of code using Optimization Techniques to make the application more efficient
• Completed testing the software using testing techniques followed by the company resulting in a 
   reduction in bugs
